wirral_hillfarm_0.text: Welcome to Hill Farm. Mind the boots. 'Wirral' is said to mean the corner of the bog-myrtle, so we have been damp a thousand years.
Vikings settled on the Wirral around 902, led by a man called Ingimund. Thingwall, just up the road, was where they held their assembly.

wirral_hillfarm_1.text: He says he will tidy the barn. He has said that since I married him.
